reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

source_record.repair: Replace the universal reading of the native arrow chain with typed, guarded relations. A named practice may have definitional conditions, mechanisms can reinforce one another, and assurance rules can require evidence before authorized exposure. None establishes one serial lifecycle for all Agile work.

relations.guard: Applying Fowler’s self-testing CI definition to interacting software changes.
relations.contribution: A build/test check is part of that CI formulation; failing it defeats the conformance claim.
relations.not_implied: TDD, complete defect freedom, or that all integration everywhere requires automation.
relations.cost: Test design, maintenance and flaky-check repair.
relations.counter_control: A manual one-off integration can be valid engineering without being CI.

relations.guard: Repeated changes to interacting maintained code.
relations.contribution: Checks, integration and structural change can reinforce the ability to change safely.
relations.not_implied: A global temporal order or a refactoring event before every release.
relations.cost: Automation and restructuring investment may exceed short-lived artifact value.
relations.counter_control: A developer can refactor and verify an isolated unmerged module before its first integration. This supplies a local changeability control without making a release or CI claim. A simple verified first release also need not follow any refactoring event.

relations.guard: Exposure of a candidate release with applicable assurance/authorization requirements.
relations.contribution: Readiness evidence and applicable authorization must address the same configuration before the claimed permitted exposure.
relations.not_implied: All feedback must wait for a production release; simulated/prototype evidence can precede it.
relations.cost: Qualification effort, evidence maintenance and release delay.
relations.counter_control: An explicitly bounded nonproduction prototype can inform a decision without meeting production release criteria.

relations.guard: Product adaptation whose target outcome is uncertain or delayed.
relations.contribution: Relevant observations, interpretation and decision rights determine whether feedback can alter an admissible choice.
relations.not_implied: All five properties are independent universal prerequisites; a direct immediate outcome may make a surrogate unnecessary.
relations.cost: Research access, measurement delay, coordination and attention.
relations.counter_control: A simple reversible user request can be decided directly without an experimentation platform or long-outcome model.

relations.guard: Local changes affect shared system or assurance constraints.
relations.contribution: Local autonomy is bounded by the actual interface and release authority.
relations.not_implied: Central control of every implementation detail or a universal scaling framework.
relations.cost: Coordination latency versus externalized system risk.
relations.counter_control: A fully independent local decision should not incur coordination merely because a large organization exists.

relations.guard: Batch and concurrency policies influence setup, waiting, learning and workload.
relations.contribution: Reducing one local metric can increase total burden or pressure.
relations.not_implied: A unique cadence or WIP optimum across workflows.
relations.cost: Include idle capacity, queues, interruptions, fixed costs and worker pressure.
relations.counter_control: An exception for urgent independent work can improve outcomes without rejecting WIP control.

relations.guard: An online service with permitted failure tolerance and meaningful measurements.
relations.contribution: Operational evidence can constrain release pace and trigger corrective work.
relations.not_implied: A safety constraint can be discharged by aggregate availability or a conventional error budget.
relations.cost: Observability, response coverage and diverted feature capacity.
relations.counter_control: A hard hazard may require separate verification irrespective of service budget.

relations.guard: Durable shared capabilities have ongoing users and costs.
relations.contribution: Continued ownership can preserve learning, but periodic value/cost review can justify redesign, handover or retirement.
relations.not_implied: Permanent teams or platforms are necessary for all products.
relations.cost: Include the platform provider, migration, coordination and maintenance, not just consumer convenience.
relations.counter_control: A project with competent handover or a simple library can meet the same continuity need.

relations.guard: Irreversible/coupled decisions influence qualities and conformance.
relations.contribution: Architectural scenarios, requirements and verification evidence should use a consistent system boundary and configuration.
relations.not_implied: Complete upfront specification of every reversible detail.
relations.cost: Analysis/evidence cost versus avoided late commitment.
relations.counter_control: Use experiment/prototype for uncertain reversible parts while stabilizing a required interface.

relations.guard: Continuing teams need learning and knowledge resilience.
relations.contribution: A process improvement requires capacity to execute it and sufficient distributed understanding to retain it.
relations.not_implied: Mandatory pairing, guaranteed morale or a universal 40-hour law.
relations.cost: Learning/collaboration time and possible context switching versus dependency reduction.
relations.counter_control: Targeted review and documentation may supply the needed resilience at lower cost.

configurations.name: Small reversible software change
configurations.guard: Low consequence, clear oracle, little coupling, short artifact life.
legitimate_omissions: No automatic Sprint, platform, error budget, product mode or formal architecture program.
configurations.minimum_control: Confirm behavior, retain normal version identity and make a bounded decision.
configurations.failure: Treating low consequence as unverified permission where a hidden external dependency exists.
configurations.validation: Author constructed configuration; target details not assessed.

configurations.name: XP-style evolving product
configurations.guard: Repeated interacting software changes, available feedback and economical automated checks.
legitimate_omissions: Pairing/TDD may be replaced for a generic property configuration, but claiming conformance to a specific XP version requires its own rules.
configurations.minimum_control: Maintain integration and verification, observed value questions and actual capacity.
configurations.failure: Select management cadence while neglecting technical health; or impose all practices without cost evaluation.
configurations.validation: A coherent configuration, not empirically validated as a whole by this study.

configurations.name: Scrum-managed delivery with engineering controls
configurations.guard: Complex product work benefits from explicit goals, inspection and adaptation.
legitimate_omissions: Generic property use does not require Scrum. Named Scrum conformance requires the current Guide elements.
configurations.minimum_control: Use verified increments and supplement the framework with appropriate engineering.
configurations.failure: Treat Scrum completion as a complete security, safety or value argument.
configurations.validation: Framework plus contextual controls; not a ranking of methods.

configurations.name: Flow-oriented service work
configurations.guard: Variable arrivals, blocking and heterogeneous work make one iteration boundary costly.
legitimate_omissions: No fixed Sprint or universal WIP=1; exception policies can be explicit.
configurations.minimum_control: Define work, start/finish, capacity policy and decision-useful flow measures.
configurations.failure: Improve item throughput by splitting items while delayed value and quality worsen.
configurations.validation: Guide-informed configuration; optimal parameters not established.

configurations.name: Assurance-constrained adaptive engineering
configurations.guard: Applicable hazard, security, configuration or independent verification obligations.
legitimate_omissions: Live progressive exposure may be inapplicable; iteration can remain within simulation, design or verified increments.
configurations.minimum_control: Identify binding authority; retain matched configuration/evidence and appropriate independence.
configurations.failure: Release theater: a green pipeline substitutes for unresolved hazard or authorization.
configurations.validation: Normative scope and feasibility reports; no certification or universal superiority claim.

configurations.name: Multi-team product/platform system
configurations.guard: Material shared dependencies and ongoing operational outcomes.
legitimate_omissions: A branded scaling framework or dedicated platform team is not automatically necessary.
configurations.minimum_control: Bound responsibility, shared interfaces, feedback and total provider/consumer cost.
configurations.failure: Autonomous local teams optimize output while unowned dependencies and workload accumulate.

constructed_cost_example.domain: Integer batch size q>=1 for a hypothetical repeated qualification process.
constructed_cost_example.units: Total normalized cost per item measured in illustrative cost-units.
constructed_cost_example.assumptions: Setup cost 100 per batch; added waiting/risk cost q per item; other costs constant; no empirical calibration.
constructed_cost_example.conclusion: This admitted model defeats a universal claim that q=1 always minimizes total cost. It does not estimate an actual project optimum.
constructed_cost_example.counter_control: If setup cost approaches zero and other premises change, q=1 may be optimal.

source_record.cross_lineage_status: NOT_ASSESSED_HERE: the all-trifecta synthesis needs the other selected native units and independently assessed directional interfaces. Shared vocabulary or citation is not a qualified transfer.

novelty_investigation.candidate: A portfolio of feedback loops with separate clocks
novelty_investigation.bearer: A decision system with technical, product and assurance latencies.
novelty_investigation.derivation: Different signals and authority conditions can justify distinct cadences.
novelty_investigation.removal_test: Without delayed outcomes the proxy clause disappears; without assurance the qualification clock disappears; feedback selection already handles remaining cases.
novelty_investigation.failure_witness: One Sprint clock forces either premature value claims or unnecessary delay.
novelty_investigation.distinctness: Subsumed by EA-01 plus guarded relations D03/D04.
novelty_investigation.ceiling: Constructed composition, no empirical combined benefit.

novelty_investigation.bearer: A team process whose changes may affect external obligations.
novelty_investigation.derivation: Local adaptation must preserve actual external constraints.
novelty_investigation.removal_test: Without an external constraint, ordinary authorized adaptation remains; without local delegation, the authority question still exists.
novelty_investigation.failure_witness: A retrospective votes away required independent verification.
novelty_investigation.distinctness: A joint scope constraint already expressed by EA-16/24, not a three-parent necessary property.
novelty_investigation.ceiling: Authority logic does not establish an adopted control.

novelty_investigation.bearer: Comparisons across differently decomposed work or outcome horizons.
novelty_investigation.derivation: A nominally equal denominator can hide different granularity or outcome meaning.
novelty_investigation.removal_test: The hazard can arise in one team without EA-19 and without a delayed outcome; measurement validity alone covers it.
novelty_investigation.failure_witness: Effort per requirement improves solely because requirements were split.
novelty_investigation.distinctness: Subsumed by EA-17; N12 supplies a concrete reported limitation, not a new property.
novelty_investigation.ceiling: No estimate of how much the published comparison is biased.
